items.title: nanoMuse: an open-source personal agent that spans your devices
items.summary: An open-source framework for personal agents that live on every device you own yet share one continuous conversation — pick up a task on another device without re-explaining everything.

items.title: Rapid-MLX: local inference on Apple Silicon, tuned for coding agents
items.summary: A local inference service for Apple Silicon, specifically optimized for the tool calling that coding agents rely on, so local models run agent workflows faster and more reliably.

items.title: MagInkDash: a Raspberry Pi-rendered, battery-powered e-ink dashboard
items.summary: A build that pairs a Raspberry Pi with a battery-powered e-ink panel: calendars, weather, to-dos and more become a low-power, glanceable dashboard you can leave anywhere.
